FN-ZY36KRK-4
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 202
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/01/2025
House Bill 202 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase the obligations of: (1)
all state and local law enforcement agencies by an undetermined amount to comply with the
reporting requirements provided in this bill; and (2) the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency, by
an undetermined amount, to compile and report annually certain data to the Legislature.
In addition, this bill could increase the obligations of the Legislature to reimburse legislative
members of the Joint Legislative Study Commission on Law Enforcement Officer Recruitment
Retention, created pursuant to the provisions of this bill, for per diem and travel expenses by an
estimated $2,300 per meeting beginning in fiscal year 2028.
